name: seated supported scissor kicks
description: Alternating straight-leg kicks from a reclined seated position, challenging the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Sit on the floor and place your hands behind your hips for support.
Lean back slightly, brace your abdomen and lift both straight legs off the floor.
Raise one leg while lowering the other, alternating in a controlled scissor rhythm.
Keep your trunk steady and stop before your lower back strains.
